secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key (Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public)

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key, server-only (Project Settings → API → Project API keys → service_role)

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Postgres connection string for Drizzle (Supabase → Project Settings → Database → connection string)

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for AI features (inbox classification, project recommendations, finance CFO). Optional — only needed when using AI actions.
